messages:
mina: Can someone explain the bagpipe outro? i laughed so hard i spilled my tea. :tea: :bagpipes:
rob: Bagpipes + slide deck crescendo = instant classic. replay when?

chris: :clap: :clap: also: shoutout to infra for not letting the demo burn down the cluster. heroic.
ops-bot: Ops note: office snacks restocked (cookies, GF cookies, oat bars). :white_check_mark:

rob: :cookie: (will defend pantry supply with my life)

chris: lol at "defend pantry". also who made the hand-drawn mascot in slide 12? masterpiece.
mina: that was @rob at 2am. art school cred revoked. :art: :sleeping:
